skills.project-tests:
# Pruebas de proyecto para agentes
1. Lista sin ejecutar: `wysna project test --discover --list --frozen --output-format=json-v1`.
2. Usa los IDs exactos de result.cases: `--case test:example`; --filter conserva selección por subcadena.
3. Ejecuta con `--expect-plan-hash <result.plan_hash> --output-format=json-v1 --report-json tests.json --report-junit tests.xml`.
4. Lee result.cases[].failure_kind, diagnostics y los hashes de stdout/stderr; no interpretes texto de terminal.
5. W5005 indica plan obsoleto: vuelve a listar. Una suite vacía devuelve 2; una cancelación devuelve 130.
6. std/test ofrece igualdad genérica, tolerancia flotante, opcionales y fixture_directory(); los fixtures se eliminan después del caso.
El hash cubre manifiesto, lock, versión y entradas seleccionadas, no todos los imports. El SDK native-core-v1 ejecuta estos comandos sin Python.
7. Dependencias: `wysna packages pack --manifest dependency/wysna.toml -o dependency.tar`; adquiere con `packages fetch --manifest wysna.toml --archive dependency.tar --sha256 <pin> --cache <cache>`, agrega con `packages add alias --path vendor/<pin>` y ejecuta `project lock`.
8. Restaura con `packages restore --cache <cache>` y verifica con `project test --frozen`; todas las operaciones admiten `--output-format=json-v1`, sin hooks ni registro remoto.
skills.overview:
# Wysna v{version} — Agent-First Native Language & Toolchain
- Default workflow uses checked static inspection before execution.
- Memory model: Atomic ARC + Copy-on-Write (`Weak[C]` breaks strong cycles); shared mutable objects are not statically thread-safe.
- Error channel: Typed values `T ! E`, unwrap with `?` or `else err { fallback }`.
- Core agent loop: `wysna skills` -> `wysna graph` -> `wysna inspect` -> `wysna patch` -> `wysna fix` -> `wysna check`.
- Topics available: overview, agent-loop, syntax, graph, patch, project-tests, contracts, stdlib.
skills.agent-loop:
# Agent Coding Loop (Token-Efficient, Hash-Guarded)
1. Discover relationships: `wysna graph <file.wysna> --output-format=json-v1`
2. Inspect one symbol instead of reading whole files: `wysna inspect <file.wysna> --symbol <name> --with-deps --output-format=json-v1`
3. Submit checked edits guarded by graph hash: `wysna patch <file.wysna> --symbol <name> --expect-graph-hash <hash> --with <code> --apply`
4. Auto-repair mechanical diagnostics: `wysna fix --apply --output-format=json-v1 <file.wysna>`
5. Decode any Wxxxx error: `wysna explain --code W2001 --output-format=json-v1`
6. Verify & bound runtime: `wysna run --max-steps=100000 --max-heap-mb=64 <file.wysna>`
skills.syntax:
# Wysna Canonical Syntax Quick Reference
- Bindings: `let x = 1` (immutable), `let mut y = 2` (mutable).
- Functions: `fn add(a: int, b: int) -> int { return a + b }`
- Cooperative Async: `async fn fetch_id() -> int { ... }`, `let v = await task`.
- Optionals & Errors: `T?`, `T ! E`, unwrap `?`, recover `expr else err { fallback }`.
- OOP & Contracts: `interface Drawable { fn draw() -> str }`, `class Rect implements Drawable { fn draw() -> str { ... } }`.
- Lambdas: `|n: int| => n * n` (capture outer variables by immutable snapshot by design; use a `class` or return updated values for mutable state).
- Canonical forms: `Class(...)`, `None`, `_ =>`, parenthesized tuple patterns.
- Match patterns: alternatives `1 | 2`, Int64 ranges `0..=10`, nested `Point { x, .. }`; W6003 reports unreachable arms.
- Static attributes on top-level functions: `@deprecated("message")` (W6004), `@must_use` (W6005); custom typed metadata: `struct AgentTool { name: str }`, `@AgentTool(name: "lookup")`; literal str/bool/int fields, no macros or evaluation.
- Ranges & Loops: `for i in 0..10 { ... }`, inclusive `0..=10`.
- Non-exhaustive match W2003 includes data.uncovered_pattern_families for checked repairs.
skills.graph:
# Semantic Relationship Graph (`wysna graph`)
- `wysna graph <file> --output-format=json-v1`: full nodes, edges, and `graph_hash`.
- `--symbol <name> --rel implements`: find all classes implementing an interface (or vice-versa).
- `--symbol <name> --rel usages`: find every class, function, field, and param using the type.
- `--symbol <name> --rel callers|callees`: traverse the resolved call graph.
- `--symbol <name> --rel impact`: compute transitive blast radius before refactoring.
skills.patch:
# Checked Semantic Patching (`wysna patch`)
- Dry-run check in memory (default): validates syntax, types, and interface contracts before disk writes.
- Optimistic locking: pass `--expect-graph-hash graph:...`; stale hashes fail with `[W5005]`.
- Target classes, interfaces, structs, enums, functions, or `ClassName.method`.
skills.contracts:
# Contracts, Schemas, Quotas & Trace Replay
- Pre/postconditions: `fn f(x: int) -> int requires x > 0 ensures result >= 0 { ... }` (runtime `[W4005]`).
- Tool Schema export: `wysna schema --emit-codecs --output-format=json-v1 <file.wysna>`.
- Deterministic quotas: `--max-steps=<N>`, `--max-heap-mb=<N>` (fail-stop `[W4004]`).
- Offline effect cassettes: `--record-trace <path>`, `--replay-trace <path>`.
skills.stdlib:
# Standard Library (18 Modules)
- Data & Text: `std/math`, `std/text`, `std/bytes`, `std/regex`, `std/collections`, `std/json`, `std/csv`, `std/parse`.
- Systems & I/O: `std/fs`, `std/files`, `std/buffer`, `std/env`, `std/path`, `std/process`, `std/time`.
- Network, Concurrency & Security: `std/http`, `std/async`, `std/algorithms` (`parallel_map`), `std/crypto`.

std/http.interpreter: install wysna[http] with libcurl 8.3.0 or newer
std/http.native: install libcurl 8.3.0 or newer development files and expose curl-config on PATH

limitations: native-cli capabilities describe host access and are not a sandbox
WASI Preview 1 does not provide networking, child processes, or native FFI
browser-library exposes only generated scalar and UTF-8 exports; WVal and pointers remain internal
project dependencies are local paths only
project lockfiles do not claim bit-for-bit binary reproducibility
